name: detailed-pr-comments
description: Write detailed inline PR review comments with evidence, focused fixes, and regression coverage

interface.shortDescription: Write detailed comments on changed PR lines
interface.longDescription: Explain the trigger, failure path, impact, focused fix, and regression coverage inline on the relevant changed line. Publish only when explicitly requested; otherwise return a draft.
defaultPrompt: Use $detailed-pr-comments to post a detailed inline comment on the relevant changed line.
